criteria.evidence: Read the diff: all seven [[term]] entries have name, definition, misread, sources and relations. Every relation target (job, Athena, Sri, product versus system) is a defined term. The decision ids D01, D10 and D105 have headings in docs/decisions.md, as grep showed. The tests the_ontology_file_is_sound and the_ontology_defines_the_seven_seeded_terms_with_their_meaning pass; they check that path sources exist and that the term set is exactly these seven.

criteria.criterion: The Hermes entry names both senses (Hermes Agent, Part 2 S1, not part of Athena; Hermes as Orchestration god in the Olympus Pantheon, BRIEF.md), says which is part of Olympus, and cites a source for each 'not part of' claim.
criteria.evidence: The definition names (1) Hermes Agent, 'second system studied in Part 2 (S1)', 'not part of Athena and not part of Olympus', and (2) 'the Orchestration god in the Olympus Pantheon'. It says 'Only this second sense is part of Olympus.' Each not_part_of entry has a source: BRIEF.md and docs/design/roadmap.md. BRIEF.md line 597 lists Hermes | Orchestration. The roadmap source only mentions Hermes as a studied system (minor finding).

criteria.criterion: Relations match Olympus: the system is Olympus, Athena is the strategy and learning role within it, Sri owns Olympus. No relation makes Athena the whole system.
criteria.evidence: The 'product versus system' term defines the system as Olympus, with Athena as its strategy and learning role. The relations are: Athena role_within 'product versus system', Athena owned_by Sri, and Sri owns 'product versus system'. The Athena definition says 'Athena is not the whole system: the system is Olympus.' No relation equates Athena with the system.

findings.summary: Weak source for the 'Hermes Agent is not part of Olympus' claim
findings.evidence: The cited docs/design/roadmap.md mentions Hermes only in RM-10 'Study Hermes and Athena, then compare'. It shows Hermes is studied but does not state that it is outside Olympus. The test checks only that the path exists. BRIEF.md line 43 would support the claim better.

findings.summary: There is no 'Olympus' term; 'product versus system' stands in for the system in relations
findings.evidence: The relations 'Athena role_within product versus system' and 'Sri owns product versus system' express the Olympus relations only indirectly, through that term's definition. This is acceptable given the fixed set of seven seeded terms.

summary: The retry does what was asked, and I found no blocker or major problem. It adds docs/ontology.toml with the seven seeded terms. Each term has a definition, the misread behind it, sources and relations. It also adds a Rust structural test with negative cases, decision D109 citing Olympus decision 5A, a CHANGELOG entry and a one-line pointer in docs/architecture.md. The new text avoids the banned vocabulary. In this snapshot I ran the full `cargo test --locked`: every test binary reported 0 failed, including the 9 ontology tests and xtask's athena_refers_to_no_one_who_runs_it_or_where. `cargo clippy` with `-D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are both clean. Every file changed is on the deliverables list. Two minor points: the "Hermes Agent is not part of Olympus" claim cites docs/design/roadmap.md, which only says Hermes is studied; and there is no separate "Olympus" term, so "product versus system" stands in for the system in relations.
